descriptions.subject: modified_item_inspected
descriptions.text:
You see a counterweight maul. A heavy striking head is balanced by a smaller weight below the grip. Both ends are scarred by use.
Damage: 2d6+2 per penetration.
Hit bonus: +0; Penetration bonus: +6.
Penetration uses Strength modifier (cap 50).
Attributes: Bludgeoning Cudgel.
On damaging hits, independent attempts (targets may resist):
  15%: Stunned - can't act for 2 turns (Toughness may shake it off, save 16).
Equip slots: Hand,Hand.
  - Glow-Quartz: +1 light radius while equipped
